meta.name: hyperplan
meta.description: Adversarial multi-agent planning skill. Self-orchestrates 5 hostile category members (unspecified-low, unspecified-high, deep, ultrabrain, artistry) via team-mode for ruthless cross-critique debate, distills only the defensible insights, then MANDATORILY hands the distilled insight bundle to the `plan` agent for executable plan formalization. Use when planning needs maximum rigor and surfacing of weak assumptions, blind spots, and over-engineering. Triggers: 'hyperplan', 'hpp', '/hyperplan', 'adversarial plan', 'hostile planning', 'cross-critique plan', '하이퍼플랜', '적대적 계획', '교차 비평'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 召集多个互相对抗的AI反复挑刺,只留下站得住的判断,再整理成可执行方案。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果关键决策容不得想当然,想先被自己的假设挑一遍刺。
copy.tagline_en: Stress-test a plan with adversarial AI critics, then turn the survivors into steps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if a decision is too important to get wrong and you want your assumptions attacked first

howto.what: Claude 会担任 Lead，让 5 个互相敌对的成员交叉批判，只保留经得起攻击的洞见，再强制交给 plan agent 产出可执行计划；开局先说 “HYPERPLAN MODE ENABLED!”。
howto.when: 当规划需要最高严谨度、要暴露薄弱假设与盲点时触发；说出 “hyperplan”、“hpp” 等关键词即进入。需已开启 team-mode 并在主会话以 lead 身份运行。

say.text: 用 hyperplan 规划这个重构方案，给我被攻击后剩下的结论
say.note: 会先启动敌对团队辩论，再产出计划

say.text: hyperplan：审查我的缓存层设计，找出被漏掉的边界情况
say.note: integration 视角会攻击失败路径

say.text: 用 hpp 重新规划这次数据库迁移，重点暴露过度设计
say.note: skeptic 成员会要求删减复杂性

howto.what_en: Claude becomes Lead of a 5-member hostile team: members cross-critique each other, it keeps only defensible insights, then hands them to the `plan` agent to formalize an executable plan. Starts by saying “HYPERPLAN MODE ENABLED!”
howto.when_en: Triggers when planning needs maximum rigor and must surface weak assumptions and blind spots; saying “hyperplan” or “hpp” starts it. Requires team-mode and a top-level lead session.

say_en.text: Use hyperplan to plan this refactor and show me what survived the attacks
say_en.note: Starts the hostile team debate, then produces a plan

say_en.text: hyperplan: review my caching design and find missed edge cases
say_en.note: The integration member attacks failure paths

say_en.text: Use hpp to replan the DB migration and expose over-engineering
